comparison: The CLR flows AsyncLocal through Task.Run by default and honors ExecutionContext.SuppressFlow. The Java ContextTransfer helper passes only an explicit ContextSnapshot; ambient CLR flow is outside its claim.
limits: Independent oracle, not an upstream test.
Only Task.Run and one AsyncLocal key were exercised; broader ExecutionContext and SynchronizationContext semantics remain open.
This does not make the internal Java context helper a public .NET-compatible API.
